name: apexlang-toolkit
description: Three paired skills for Oracle APEX apps written as APEXlang (.apx): apexlang-architecture decides WHERE business logic, validation and DML belong (single write-path PL/SQL packages -- entity, multi-entity flow or external-system integration -- not region-bound Automatic DML); apex-sync-guard gates apex import/export (Oracle's deploy script included) behind a Builder↔git divergence check against a recorded syncpoint, so neither replica is silently overwritten; apex-sentinel is the runtime verification gate that drives the running page in a browser before claiming a change works.
